q: 1. A series of equal payments occurring at equal period of time to obtain a certain amount is called
explain: An annuity represents a sequence of equal payments made at regular intervals over a fixed duration.

q: 2. Pick up the correct statement from the following
options: An annuity is a series of equal payments occurring at equal period of time
Annuity is called an equal payment or uniform payment series
Annuity may have periods of time of any length but should always be of equal length
explain: All three statements correctly describe the defining features of an annuity: equal payments, uniform series, and equal time intervals of any fixed length.

q: 3. The capital Recovery factor (equal payments) of Capital Recovery Annuity is
explain: The capital recovery factor converts a present sum into a series of equal annual payments: A = P × [i(1+i)^n / ((1+i)^n − 1)].

q: 4. In a cash flow series:
options: uniform gradient signifies that an income or disbursement changes by the same amount in each interest period
Either an increase or a decrease in the amount of a cash flow is called the gradient
The gradient in the cash flow may be positive or negative
explain: All three statements correctly describe a uniform gradient series: a constant change (increase or decrease, positive or negative) per period.

q: 5. If P, F and A represents present value and annual payment and future value respectively, then the Sinking amount factor is ......
explain: The sinking fund factor is A/F, the annual deposit needed to accumulate a given future sum.

q: 6. If P, F and A represents present value and annual payment and future value respectively, then the Capital recovery factor is ......
explain: The capital recovery factor is A/P, the equal annual payment that recovers a present sum.

q: 7. Find the annuity for getting 10,000 after the end of 10 years. If the annual interest rate is 12%.
8. Find the annuity for getting 10,000 at the beginning of year at a interest rate of 12% for 12 years.
explain: Calculating annuity with compounding results in 1614.

q: 9. The annuity which refers to debt payment for recovering the initial amount or capital in equal periodical payments, is known as ......
explain: A capital recovery annuity is the equal periodic payment that repays an initial capital with interest.

q: 10. If a seller recovers his capital along with accumulated compensating interest not in one single lump sum payment but in a periodical equal payments, overtime ......
options: capital recovery annuity is a valid
present work annuity is a valid
sinking fund annuity is a valid
explain: Recovering capital plus interest through equal periodic payments is a capital recovery annuity.

q: 11. The sinking fund factor is ......
explain: Sinking fund factor A/F = i / ((1+i)^n - 1).

q: 12. The capital recovery factor of capital recovery annuity is ......
explain: Capital recovery factor A/P = i(1+i)^n / ((1+i)^n - 1). Note: the minus sign in option a is smudged in the scan; I read it as the standard formula.

q: 13. Present worth annuity (PWA) is generally is generally known as ......
explain: The key accepts all of the listed names for a present worth annuity.

q: 14. The inverse of sinking fund factor is ......
explain: Sinking fund factor is A/F; its inverse F/A is the series compound amount factor.

q: 15. In a project equal investment is done to obtain a fixed amount in the future, this amount is known as
explain: A sinking fund is an annuity specifically designed to accumulate a target sum in the future.

q: 16. Amount of money payable to a beneficiary at a regular intervals for a prescribed period of time out of a fund reserved for the purpose is
explain: An annuity is a series of equal payments made at regular intervals.

q: 17. The annuity which refers to a debt payment for recovering the initial amount or capital in equal periodical payments is known as
explain: A capital recovery annuity is used to recover an initial investment (capital) through equal periodic payments over the project's life.

q: 18. Present Worth Annuity (PWA) is generally known as
explain: Per the answer key, Present Worth Annuity is known by all these alternate terms — Premium, Income, and Future annuity.

q: 19. The sum of the first cost and the present worth of all costs or replacement, operation and maintenance.
explain: Capitalized cost is the sum of the first cost plus the present worth of all future replacement, operation, and maintenance costs over an infinite/project life.

q: 20. The annuity which refers to a debt payment for recovering the initial amount or capital periodic payments, is known as
explain: As listed in the answer key, this refers to the capital/capacity recovery annuity, used to recover the initial invested amount through periodic payments.

q: 21. In a project equal investment is done for the future value then it is known as ......
explain: Equal periodic investments made to reach a future value form a sinking fund.

q: 22. The fund gradually accumulated by periodic deposit for replacement of a structure at the end of its life cycle is called ......
explain: A sinking fund is built by periodic deposits to replace an asset at the end of its life.

q: 23. An annuity whereby the payment is postponed for a certain period of time is?
explain: A deferred annuity is one where the first payment is postponed to a future date rather than starting immediately.

q: 24. The annual periodic payment for repayment of capital invested over definite period is ......
explain: An annuity certain is a series of payments over a definite period.

q: 25. The annual periodic payment for repayment of capital amount invested by party is known as
explain: Equal periodic payments that repay invested capital are an annuity.

q: 26. Annuities involve ......
explain: An annuity is a series of equal payments at equal intervals.
